parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const message = $('If').first().json.body.entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0]; const response = $('Message a model').first().json.content; const timestamp = Number(message.timestamp) * 1000; const now = Date.now(); const sessionOpen = Number.isFinite(timestamp) && timestamp > 0 && now >= timestamp && now - timestamp < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; const payload = { messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: String(message.from || '').replace(/\D/g, ''), type: 'text', text: { body: response } }; if (!sessionOpen) { payload.type = 'template'; payload.template = { name: 'emeta_reprise_conversation', language: { code: 'fr' } }; delete payload.text; } return payload; })() }}

values.content: ={{ 'Reponds en francais en tenant compte du contexte de routage ci-dessous. Si une reference de mission est fournie, rattache la reponse a cette mission; sinon traite la demande selon le numero WhatsApp et le contenu courant. Si option_b_requested est vrai et qu’aucune reference canonique n’est fournie, demande explicitement la reference MIS-2026-XXXX et ne confirme pas l’activation du handoff. Ne pretends pas consulter un dossier non fourni.\nContexte: ' + JSON.stringify($('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.routing_context) + '\nMessage entrant: ' + $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.contenu }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { Numero_WhatsApp: $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.numero_whatsapp, Message_ID: $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.message_id, Reference_Mission: $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.reference_mission, Type_Message: $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.type_message, Contenu: $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.contenu, Date_Reception_UTC: $('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.date_reception_utc, Contexte_Routage: JSON.stringify($('Prepare Incoming Context').first().json.routing_context) } }}

meta.description: Set NOCODB_API_TOKEN and NOCODB_WHATSAPP_TABLE_ID for the dedicated Logs_Communications table. Columns: Numero_WhatsApp, Message_ID, Reference_Mission, Type_Message, Contenu, Date_Reception_UTC, Contexte_Routage. Messages that request Option B and include a valid MIS-2026-XXXX reference are routed through CORTEX_04; standard messages are logged here. Set CORTEX_04_HANDOFF_SECRET to the same private value in both n8n workflows.
